parameters.name: subject_id
parameters.help_text: The capsule resolves the subject's assets under /root/capsule/data via this capsule's own subject_resolver.resolve_subject (xenium_autocoreg itself is data-layout-agnostic): Xenium-ophys-coregistered_{sid}_* (aligned-frame Xenium), ophys-z-stacks_{sid}_registered_*/segmented_* (or the multiplane-ophys_{sid}_*cortical-zstack-{registration,segmentation}_* fallback naming), and optionally Xenium_{sid}_*_processed (reporter population).

parameters.name: pose_mode
parameters.description: Anchor-section pose-seeding mode: auto | center-rotation | corners
parameters.help_text: auto (default) = fully automatic blind rotation x position x depth pose search -- no human input, but can fail outright if the true pose sits outside the searched position window. center-rotation = a human provides a rough center (center_um) and rotation (rotation_deg); only a depth sweep then runs automatically -- use this when auto fails. corners = a human provides 4 Xenium tissue-trapezoid corners (xenium_trapezoid_corners_um) + top_edge; NOT YET IMPLEMENTED upstream (2p2xenium xenium_autocoreg.pose_seed.seed_from_corners) -- its parameters are validated and passed through, but the run will fail with NotImplementedError.

parameters.name: anchor_sec
parameters.description: OPTIONAL: Xenium section number to run the initial pose search on
parameters.help_text: Blank (default) = auto-select via xenium_autocoreg.anchor.select_anchor_section (the first cell-rich section, in section order, past a density plateau). Set explicitly to override the auto pick.

parameters.name: center_um
parameters.description: REQUIRED for pose_mode=center-rotation (unless pose_json is set): rough anchor-section center 'X,Y' in um
parameters.help_text: X,Y (comma-separated) in the Xenium-aligned frame's um scale, eyeballed from a confocal/vasculature image or however already available. Ignored for pose_mode=auto.

parameters.name: rotation_deg
parameters.description: REQUIRED for pose_mode=center-rotation (unless pose_json is set): rough rotation in degrees
parameters.help_text: Rough rotation (deg) of the z-stack relative to the Xenium section. Ignored for pose_mode=auto.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: OPTIONAL for pose_mode=center-rotation: z-stack-to-Xenium scale factor
parameters.help_text: Blank (default) = the subject's own SubjectConfig.zstack_scale_to_Xenium (accounts for tissue processing shrink/expansion between modalities). Ignored for pose_mode=auto.

parameters.name: xenium_trapezoid_corners_um
parameters.description: REQUIRED for pose_mode=corners (unless pose_json is set): 4 Xenium tissue-trapezoid corners 'X1,Y1,X2,Y2,X3,Y3,X4,Y4' in um
parameters.help_text: 4 corners of the Xenium tissue trapezoid in the Xenium-aligned frame (um), as 8 comma-separated numbers (x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3,x4,y4). Ignored for pose_mode=auto/center-rotation. NOTE: pose_mode=corners is NOT YET IMPLEMENTED upstream (2p2xenium xenium_autocoreg.pose_seed.seed_from_corners) -- this parameter is validated and passed through for forward-compatibility, but the run will fail with NotImplementedError.

parameters.name: top_edge
parameters.description: REQUIRED for pose_mode=corners (unless pose_json is set): which corner/edge (0-3) is the trapezoid's short/slanted top
parameters.help_text: Fixes the correspondence order/orientation between xenium_trapezoid_corners_um and the z-stack's 4 corners. Ignored for pose_mode=auto/center-rotation.

parameters.name: zstack_corners_um
parameters.description: OPTIONAL for pose_mode=corners: the z-stack's own 4 corners, same 'X1,Y1,...,X4,Y4' shape as xenium_trapezoid_corners_um
parameters.help_text: Blank (default) = the z-stack's own canonical FOV rectangle. Ignored for pose_mode=auto/center-rotation.

parameters.name: pose_json
parameters.description: OPTIONAL: path to a JSON file with the pose-mode fields above, instead of the inline fields
parameters.help_text: For center-rotation: {"center_um": [x, y], "rotation_deg": r, "scale": s} ("scale" optional). For corners: {"xenium_trapezoid_corners_um": [[x,y]x4], "top_edge": 0, "zstack_corners_um": [[x,y]x4], "scale": s} ("zstack_corners_um" and "scale" optional). Path is resolved relative to /root/capsule/data if not absolute. Keys present in the file override the matching inline flag above -- same shape xenium_autocoreg.cli's own --pose-json takes.
